prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add durable single-step `undo` for successful `add`, `complete`, and `remove` mutations. Store the minimal prior state beside the selected data file using atomic writes. `undo` must work in a new process, restore exact task content and ordering, consume the undo record after success, and fail without changing storage when no undo is available. A failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record. Support `--json` summaries. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/undo.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON undo displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `UNDO`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$orderingDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'ordered-tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $undoComplete = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoComplete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo complete should succeed in a new process'
    $completeSummary = $undoComplete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($completeSummary.undone -eq 'complete' -and $completeSummary.taskId -eq 1) 'undo should return a JSON summary'
    $pendingAgain = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (($pendingAgain.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'pending') 'undo complete should restore the exact prior task'

    $completeAgain = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($completeAgain.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete after undo should succeed'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $undoRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo remove should succeed'
    $bannerLines = @($undoRemove.Output -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 13 -and $bannerLines[0].Contains('UNDO') -and
        $bannerLines[12] -eq 'Undid remove for task 1.') 'non-JSON undo should display the banner once before its summary'
    $restored = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (($restored.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'undo remove should restore exact task content'

    $second = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($second.ExitCode -eq 0) 'second add should succeed'
    $failedRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($failedRemove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'failed remove should fail'
    $undoAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($undoAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).undone -eq 'add') 'failed mutation should preserve the valid undo record'
    $afterUndoAdd = @(Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')).Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (@($afterUndoAdd).Count -eq 1 -and $afterUndoAdd[0].title -eq 'First task') 'undo add should restore prior content and ordering'

    $beforeUnavailableUndo = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $unavailableUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $afterUnavailableUndo = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    Assert-True ($unavailableUndo.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $beforeUnavailableUndo -ceq $afterUnavailableUndo) 'unavailable undo should fail without changing storage'

    $removeAgain = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeAgain.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove after undo checks should succeed'
    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    1..3 | ForEach-Object {
        $orderedAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', "Ordered $_", '--data-file', $orderingDataFile, '--json')
        Assert-True ($orderedAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) "ordered add $_ should succeed"
    }
    $beforeMiddleRemove = Get-Content -LiteralPath $orderingDataFile -Raw
    $middleRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $orderingDataFile, '--json')
    $middleUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $orderingDataFile, '--json')
    $afterMiddleUndo = Get-Content -LiteralPath $orderingDataFile -Raw
    Assert-True ($middleRemove.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $middleUndo.ExitCode -eq 0) 'middle remove and undo should succeed'
    Assert-True ($beforeMiddleRemove -ceq $afterMiddleUndo) 'undo remove should restore exact task content and ordering'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge base and durable undo assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
